Implementation
New host-only ServiceEvents header included by Runtime: frozen STRATA_PREFILL_SERVICE_EVENTS exact1 on first Runtime use, defaultOFF forunset/0/01/true. Queue construction returns original in_order propertylist whenOFF; whenON requires device queue_profiling aspect before constructing eachcompute/transfer/created engine queue and adds standard enable_profiling. Unsupported requestedaspect fails Runtime setup clearly; no unsupported kernel force. Production queue profiling only changes under requested diagnosticflag.
PerRuntime collector scoped RAII inside actual Prefill::run after valid nonempty input/current OnDevice; no global cumulative counts. SameRuntime overlapping scopes reject withclear exception, independent device scopes separate. Mutex+atomic active flag sharedby inline/issuer threads, no threadlocal collector. Fixed retained cap200000 eventhandles; boundedcontrolledvectorcapacity<=cap. Categorycap4096, finite emitted lines/320byte key guard, checked uint64 additions includingbytes/service/host counts; cap/alloc/key/query/pending/invalid failures markincomplete, no silent complete. Eachscope fresh count and handles; eventhandles own no operand or queue lifetime.
Scope resolves immediately AFTER existing checked final m.cs stream_sync and originalstats.ms_total sample, BEFORE optional postprefillstatecopy diagnostics. Existing issuer joins/transfer drains and Prefill exception/cleanup owners unchanged. Successful scope only queries already-complete events; no added tags/barriers/devicewaits. Exactstart>0/end>start required, zero/equal/reversed invalid. Pending/queryerror sums exclude invaliddurations and markwhole diagnostic incomplete. Per-category count/valid/bytes/hostsubmitduration/service sum/min/max; scopequery+aggregation hostoverhead separate. Sums fromdistinctqueues canoverlap, not wallutilization. Gaps may contain uncapturedkernels/dependencies/host and are not calledidle/wait. Complete means only selectedeligible capturedcommands hadvalidqueries, never allprefill/kernelcoverage.
RAII exception/earlyreturn emitsincomplete checked_boundary0 WITHOUT querying any retained events, drops diagnostic eventhandles only; existing queue drains/operandfree unchanged. No diagnostic failure replacesinference failure; record/query bookkeeping exceptions swallowed andreported, overlappingrequestedscopes are explicit unsupported admission. Query/print overhead may perturb instrumented run; not speedneutral or productionperformanceproof.

Exact hooks
Grouped GEMM productionvoidwrapper times common submit_grouped diagnostic=false; retainsreturned exactleafevent+backend G/max_rows/N/K/XMXtile/pipeline, no executablebundlequery addedinproduction. Unchanged selectedactualXMX/joint_matrix(MMA)/DP4a. GU N1280/K2560 vsDown N2560/K640 distinguish byshape; fallbacktile0 remainsleaf-owned/unspecified. Kernel math/dispatch andfinish waitpolicy unchanged.
Native iq_dequant_gu_group_f16/down_group_f16 retain exactparallel_for event aftervalidnonemptygroups, format t/groupcount/firstexpert/N/K. GU metadataN=2*n_ff K=n_embd; DownN=n_embd K=n_ff. All originalbounds/type/workgroups/math andsync_if_needed unchanged. Otherdequant/verify/decodekernels notcaptured.
GPU copy/copy_async/copy_async_after and Runtime::copy_async preserveactualreturnedmemcpy event, bytes,source/dest actual get_pointer_type inqueuecontext. source/destinationlabels device_usm/host_usm/shared_usm/unknown_pageable_or_unregistered; standardSYCL cannotprove thatunknownispageablehost vsunregistered/crosscontextdevice, so no inferreddevice/physicalDMA. Direction is explicitsrc->dstpair. Zero-bytenocommandpaths excluded; existingcopy_async_after zero dependency submission stillhappens butnotcaptured. Nullstreamsync/async behavior preserved verbatim(waitonly whereexistingcopywaited).
Hooks check actual Runtimeowner_of_stream(queue), activeScope and existing gpu::is_capturing; graphcapturenodes excluded/countmarked, graphlogic unchanged/no retained graphevents/query. Diagnosticstandalonequeues notRuntime-owned ignored. Actual clock beforeandafter API enqueue excludes pointerclassification/collectorlocks/categoryaggregation fromhost_submit_ns; grouped interval includesexistingselector/eligibility/leaflaunch (hostAPI cost, notpureenqueueCPUinstructiontime). DefaultOFF doesnotclock/query/record orenableprofiling, though small inert hosthook calls/stackmetadata exist; no defaultspeed claim.

Concurrency/lifetime limits
Attribution is perRuntime actualPrefill submissionWINDOW, not independentrequest tags. Existing scheduler mustnot submit unrelated selectedcopies/kernels on sameRuntime during its Prefill scope; task's serialized modelrecipe meets this. Other concurrent Runtimeleafwork wouldbe countedinwindow, no claim arbitrary concurrentrequest attribution. SameRuntime Prefill overlap explicitlyrefused; multipleRuntime pipeline scopes allowed. Scopeclosure reliesexistingjoined issuers/drains; lateunrelated submissions outsideactivewindow excluded. Collector never waits for event or owns operands; retainedhandle lifetimes endafterquery orabandon. Locks are hostCPU only. Pointerclassification query failures markincomplete. Graphlookup existingfail()behavior unchanged; Main review malformedqueuecases. Header hasnoSYCL devicekernel orhost_task/spin/poll/systematomic added.

Main exact required checks (ALL UNEXECUTED)
Review seven sourcefiles/queue constructor API, cap/query/exception/graphscope/lifetime and sourcepins beforeapply/test. Meaningful Main fixtures: exactflagunset/0/01/true givesoldqueueproperties vs1 profiling; overlappingbegin rejection/twoscope reset; cap200000+1 andcategorycap+1 markincomplete; allocationexception; positive/zero/equal/reversedtimestamp; pendingquery mustnotinvokeprofilinggetter; queryexception/incomplete; abortscope noquery; graphcapture/zerocopy excluded; actual copiedevent retained withbytes/srcdsttype labels includingunknown. These needactualcollector seam/mock strategy Main devises, no mirrorcounttest proposed asqualification.
ActualfiniteGPU qualification Mainonly underownedmeasurementlock: pinnedsource/binary/compiler/provider/libraries/device identity, freshnativeintegerhealth/faultcursors before/after, oneownedmodeljob, finitewall/CPU/RSS/logcaps, normalSTOP/QUIT/reap andoriginalfailurestatus preserve. First small supported Prefill guardedinstrumentedflag1, confirmselectedbackend/dequant/copycategories/pointerlabels andpositivequerysamples/incompleteclassification. Only then onebounded actual32K recipe ifMainauthorizes, sameexisting safetyENV/inputs/pins, no extra profiler/reset/retry. Sampleinstrumenteddiagnostic separatelyfromquiet baselinerecipe; recordeventcapture/hostclock/aggregationoverhead, originalprefill/decode/individualoutput/faultresults, categorycoverage andincompletecodes. No sum-as-wall-utilization, gap-as-idle, physicalDMA/roofline/end-to-end speedclaim. RealGPU/NVIDIAcoverage whereavailable Mainonly; otherwiseunverified.
